_: Commanding the King's hosts (realm/scripts/host_command.gd; Warcraft III's fixed command card and ground ring, Total War's banner that glows when selected and its route on the campaign map). on: the switch (or --hosts=on / --hosts=off). pick_px: how near the pointer must be to a host's standard, in screen pixels, to select it. ring: the ground ring under a selected host (radius in world units, plus so much per company, up to max; colour). glow: the light on a selected host's banner. route: the dotted line to where a host is ordered (dot size and spacing in world units; colour, and alpha for a host not selected). town_reach: an order given this near a town's centre, in world units (a tile is 4), goes to the town rather than to the ground. orders: the command card, left to right (READY.md line 8: march, attack, besiege, hold, go home; research section 1 point 8), each with its icon (realm/assets/icons, Phosphor) and words on hover, and aim: true for an order that waits for the King to click where (the ground, a town, a foe); its hotkey is the Input Map action host_<order> (keys.gd, changeable in Settings). doing: what the card says the host is doing, by its order's kind ({to} where it is bound, {road} how many seasons away; there: once it has arrived). face (Total War's drag to face, research point 7): with a host selected, a right-drag longer than drag_px on screen draws the line the host will form on, a ghost mark per company (ghost: size and colour), and on release marches it there facing away from the line as dragged (left to right faces up the screen).

orders.tip: March: then click where on the map, or a town (right-click also marches; right-drag to set the line it forms on)
Attack: then click a foe's host to fall on it
Besiege: then click a foe's town to lay siege to it
Garrison: then click a town of yours or of a house sworn to you
Go home: march home to the King's seat
Split: half its companies stand apart as a host of their own
